description: List all stream keys for live broadcasting. Returns array of {id, title, region, default, stream_key, in_use, in_use_by: {live_id, title, status}, created_at}. A key is held (in_use) by a live that is online, provisioning, expired, waiting to start or scheduled within 24h; an expired live holds it until regenerated or deleted. stream_key is a secret credential: show it only when the user asks for it (e.g. to set up OBS).
name: panda_list_stream_keys
title: List Stream Keys
